integrity: The proof is algebraic and all-prime; exact finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof. The review is self-review and not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Prime fields only, not prime-power fields. Complex-linear operator-tomography rank and kernel only; no nonlinear pure-state phase retrieval implication or sharp singular-value spectrum. Unindexed equivalent calculations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact rank and Weyl-kernel classification for quartic-graph Gabor tomography
